claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 16340 550mAh 4A as a 550mAh preset with a 4A runtime rating.

AW IMR 16340 550mAh samples are documented with a red wrapper and button top; the comparison guide measured one tested sample at 16.6 mm × 33.7 mm, while a later review reports an incompatible 14 mm × 49 mm dimension.

The AW IMR 16340 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AW IMR 16340 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2016-04-24 or earlier.
